title: VooPoo Doric Galaxy Replacement Pods - 2 Pack
description: Elevate your vaping with Voopoo Galaxy Pods, designed specifically for the Voopoo Doric Galaxy Pen. These pods come equipped with a 1.2ohm or 0.7ohm integrated mesh coil, delivering an exceptional Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) experience, making every puff a flavourful journey. Each pod in this pack of two features a 2ml e-liquid capacity with a convenient side-filling design, ensuring easy refills without any mess. The pods' construction includes a POM drip tip, optimized for MTL vaping, providing a comfortable and satisfying draw that mimics the feel of traditional smoking. Compatibility is key, and these pods seamlessly fit with your Voopoo Doric Galaxy Pen. Whether you're a seasoned vaper or new to the scene, these pods provide an efficient and enjoyable vaping experience, enhancing the flavours of your favourite e-liquids . Make the most out of your Voopoo Doric Galaxy Pen with these Galaxy Pods. Their integrated mesh coils guarantee a consistent and flavourful vape, while their design ensures a leak-free and convenient experience. These pods are compatible with the Voopoo Doric Galaxy and Doric Galaxy S1 pod vape kits.
